item.title: Kerry estate agent says new private student accommodation unlikely in Tralee any time soon
item.description: A Kerry estate agent says it’s unlikely any private student accommodation will be built in Tralee any time soon. Paul Stephenson of Sherry Fitzgerald Stephenson Crean says the cost of building apartments is not viable in most of the country at the moment. Figures from the Department of Housing show that in the first 11 months of 2025, building commenced on just 25 new apartments in Kerry. item.title: Vincent de Paul says many working families in Kerry would fare better on social welfare
item.description: Many families whom the St Vincent de Paul in Kerry helped out in 2025, were in households where two people were working, but were still unable to pay the bills. That's according to Tralee Area President Sinead Donnelly, who says it's been another extremely busy year for the society in Kerry. Figures show that calls for help were up by 25 percent in 2025, but this is understand to be a modest estimate. item.title: Treble For Jack Kennedy On Day 1 Of Leopardstown Festival
item.description: Dingle Jockey rode a treble on the opening day of the Leopardstown Christmas Racing Festival. The Kerry man piloted 8/15 favourite Romeo Coolio to win the feature race, the Grade One Racing Post Novice Chase. He was on board 7/4 shot Ballyfad to win the TRI Equestrian Maiden Hurdle in the opening race. item.title: Redknapp Rules As The Jukebox Man Wins King George VI Chase
item.description: The Jukebox Man has won a thrilling renewal of the King George for owner Harry Redknapp. Former Spurs and West Ham boss Redknapp watched his 7-to-1 shot claim victory by a nose ahead of Banbridge in today's feature at Kempton. Harry gave his reaction after the race on Racing TV. Advertisement

item.title: Munster Prepare For Unique Double Over Leinster
item.description: Munster are aiming to secure a unique double over provincial rivals Leinster tomorrow night in a sold-out URC Round 8 derby at Thomond Park. Munster forward Jack O'Donoghue has been speaking ahead of the game. Advertisement Leinster Hooker Ronan Kelleher says the game provides his side with an opportunity to right the wrongs of their defeat to Munster at Croke Park. Munster versus Leinster kicks off at 7.45pm.

item.title: Kerry Fire Service had 16% increase in call-outs in 2025
item.description: The Kerry Fire Service experienced a 16% increase in call-outs in 2025. Up to 17th of December, the county’s fire service responded to 1,750 incidents, which is up from just over 1500 (1506) incidents during the same period last year. The Kerry Fire Service responded to 432 fires so far this year. Advertisement A significant number of those were gorse fires. item.title: 17 new zones for speed cameras in Kerry
item.description: Gardaí have announced 17 new zones in Kerry where speed cameras will be in operation from 1st January. Safety cameras operate in areas where there is a history of speed-related collisions known as speed enforcement zones. There were already 76 such areas in Kerry, but from 1st January, there will be 17 new areas where speed cameras may be placed.
